name: Tucanos Brazilian Grill (Orem, UT) "Abacaxi" Roasted Brown Sugar Pineapple (Bromelain Mod)
brandOrRestaurant: Tucanos Brazilian Grill (Orem / University Place, UT)
whyItWorks: Whole fresh pineapple glazed with brown sugar and cinnamon, roasted on skewers until soft and caramelized. Roasting deactivates harsh raw enzymes while retaining gentle digestive bromelain.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Accept 2-3 warm slices of roasted pineapple; enjoy as a digestive palate cleanser after grilled meats.
watchOuts: Limit to 2-3 slices to avoid excessive sugar and fruit acid
